calls.title: GrowthBook Onboarding Kick-Off
calls.summary: The team discussed the migration to GrowthBook, where 1,000 features are now actively used by 100,000 daily users, demonstrating solid readiness after three months. Emphasis was placed on the need for payload encryption for Enterprise use, a primary factor driving the upgrade to Enterprise features. Onboarding sessions were proposed to better guide the team, with Chris Sanders offering a detailed session. Additionally, Server-Sent Events are currently disabled to reduce hosting costs, and follow-up calls will be arranged to explore configurations to enable it at a lower cost. The Enterprise license key is pending, with team members encouraged to expedite communication via Slack for a timely resolution to unlock additional capabilities.
calls.keywords: Feature Flags, Encryption, Enterprise License, Experimentation, Server-Sent Events (SSE), GrowthBook Support
